records.scope_notes: Normative, descriptive and prescriptive analysis of human judgments and decisions; the official scope explicitly includes analysis of existing data. notes: Ten candidates: seven verified standard subscription routes with explicit journal-specific no-submission/no-publication-fee statements, two Springer candidates needing further fee verification, and Judgment and Decision Making retained as a conditional-waiver lead with unresolved submission charges.

Verification is a bounded reading of current official pages, not a guarantee of future policy or acceptance. Standard compliant publication is distinct from optional Gold OA, printed color, editing, permissions and other elected services.

Discovery is concentrated in Sage because its current journal-specific pages explicitly cover submission and publication. Diamond/university outlets are intentionally left to the independent expansion role; publisher concentration is a coverage limitation, not a ranking recommendation.

Elsevier Cognitive Psychology, Journal of Mathematical Psychology and Journal of Experimental Social Psychology, and Taylor & Francis Thinking & Reasoning were considered but omitted after direct author-policy fetches were blocked or incomplete. No-APC statements alone were not promoted to verified-free claims.
No impact factors, citation metrics, acceptance rates or turnaround statistics are asserted. Difficulty remains unknown until separate ranking review.

Existing-data, computational and synthesis suitability is an agent interpretation of each official scope and article-type policy. People remain responsible for design, ethical/data permissions, interpretation, authorship and AI-use disclosure. Further manuscript-specific policies apply.

Peer-review labels concern regular research/review submissions. Editorials, book reviews and other special formats can use different review arrangements and are not represented as equivalent research outputs.
